out.rationale: The passage states the setup is modeled on Kenton et al. (2024); the citing work adds a systematic study of the scaling behavior of debate, finding that on TruthfulQA the Guard's (judge's) performance scales with general intelligence rating while Houdini performance stays constant, and notes that prior work only tests a few models and has not explicitly compared different judges, which extends the protocol.
out.scope: proposed EXTENDS: Debate as a scalable oversight protocol with a judge and debaters; holds for the debate setup modeled on Kenton et al., not for Kenton et al.'s consultancy or direct-QA comparisons; the finding that the Guard's performance scales while Houdini performance stays constant is shown on TruthfulQA, with similar scaling on QuALITY and PrOntoQA and mostly flat performance for both Guards and Houdinis on BoolQ

text: The authors say they systematically study the scaling behavior of debate as a scalable oversight protocol, modeling their setup on Kenton et al. (2024), with the debaters as Houdinis and the judge as the Guard. On TruthfulQA, Houdini performance stays constant while the Guard's performance scales with general intelligence rating, which they call consistent with prior work including Kenton et al., though that work tested only a few models and did not explicitly compare different judges.
title: Engels et al. model their debate game on Kenton et al.'s debate setup to study scaling
